title: Tom Is Sick
text:
Tom is sick today. He has a headache and a cold. He stays in bed. His mother gives him soup and water.

Tom goes to the doctor in the afternoon. The doctor is kind. She says Tom needs rest and medicine. After three days, Tom feels better.

questions.text: Who does Tom go to see in the afternoon?
Why does Tom stay in bed?
options: He needs to rest because he is sick
He is waiting for a friend

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: something you take to help you get better when you are ill

paragraph_translations: Tomek jest dzisiaj chory. Ma ból głowy i przeziębienie. Zostaje w łóżku. Mama daje mu zupę i wodę.
Tomek idzie do lekarza po południu. Lekarz jest miły. Ona mówi, że Tomek potrzebuje odpoczynku i lekarstwa. Po trzech dniach Tomek czuje się lepiej.
